name: Moonshine Meadery
tagline: Pune maker of mead, the honey-based alcoholic drink
excerpt: Moonshine Meadery brought India's mead category to Shark Tank India Season 1, Episode 22.
content:
Moonshine Meadery makes mead, an alcoholic drink brewed from honey, under the company Ronin Wines in Pune. It appeared in the 22nd episode of Shark Tank India's first season, aired on 18 January 2022, which SET India billed as featuring the world's oldest alcohol.

Reports on the outcome of the pitch come from blogs rather than outlets we rely on, so we do not state the ask or the result here.

Since the show, Ronin Wines raised a $675k pre-Series A in 2023, co-led by Zerodha-backed Rainmatter Capital and Grip Invest, to improve sales and distribution and promote better beekeeping. Inc42's filing data shows revenue slipping in FY25 and a continuing loss.

shark_tank.pitch_summary: The team pitched mead, a honey-based drink, as a new alcohol category for India.

faq.q: Is Moonshine Meadery still in business?
faq.a: Yes. Ronin Wines, its maker, filed accounts for FY25.
Inc42's filing data shows total revenue of about ₹8.0 crore in FY25, with a net loss.

lessons: Our analysis: for a brand creating a new category, TV exposure can matter more as consumer education than as funding.
notes: BELOW PUBLISHING BAR. Ask (₹80 lakh for 0.5%) and the no-deal outcome (founders rejected counter-offers) come only from blogs and a Shopify India blog interview; deal.made left out. Founders (Rohan Rehani, Nitin Vishwas) also only from those sources, so left out. No single-pitch official clip found; pitch_video is the official full episode.
